title: Asghar Mera Pyasa Hoga
body:
Haaye 6 mah ke bachche ko khabar ye bhi nhi
Maa se yun dur hua hai ke jahan koi nhi
Khud ko tanhai mein kis tarha sambhala hoga
Bano kehti thi ke Asghar mera pyasa hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
Mere bachche ne mujhe kabr mein dhunda hoga
Bano kehti thi ke Asghar mera pyasa hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
1
Zakhm bhi halq pe bachche ke abhi taza hai
Teer khakar bhi abhi lal mera pyasa hai
Aise aalam mein mujhe usne pukara hoga
Bano kehti thi ke Asghar mera pyasa hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
2
Loriya deke mere lal ko behlayega kon
Shab mein royega mera bachcha to samjhayega kon
Mujhko har lamha wo awaaz lagata hoga
Bano kehti thi ke Asghar mera pyasa hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
3
Haaye 6 mah ke bachche ko khabar ye bhi nhi
Maa se yun dur hua hai ke jahan koi nhi
Khud ko tanhai mein kis tarha sambhala hoga
Bano kehti thi ke Asghar mera pyasa hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
4
Ashq kab tak yunhi aankho se bahayegi robab
Haaye kis tarha se Asghar ko bhulayegi robab
Samne aankho ke besheer ka jhula hoga
Bano kehti thi ke Asghar mera pyasa hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
5
Nanhi mayyat ko liye god mein sheh rote hai
Kya khabar thi ke yahan bachche naher hote hai
Aaj besheer ke aankho mein andhera hoga
Bano kehti thi ke Asghar mera pyasa hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
6
Lashe Asghar ko liye shah chale sue haram
Bas yhi soch ke uthte nhi maula ke qadam
Ek maa ne to kabhi ye bhi na socha hoga
Bano kehti thi ke Asghar mera pyasa hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
7
Chand pe zulm ki bano ke ghata chayi hai
Qabr ki god mein besheer ki tanhai hai
Aaj ki shab mein to Asghar nhi soya hoga
Bano kehti thi ke Asghar mera pyasa hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
8
Maa ki aagosh ko chora to mili garm zameen
Qabr mein sirf andhero ke siwa kuch bhi nhi
Aise mahol mein bachcha mera rota hoga
Bano kehti thi ke Asghar mera pyasa hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
9
Apne bachche ko nahi bhulne paati hai robab
Aaj bhi jhula e besheer jhulati hai robab
Haaye is maa ka khuda jaane ke ab kya hoga
Bano kehti thi ke Asghar mera pyasa hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
10
Jis ghari jhulae besheer nazar aata hai
Soch kar maa ka kaleja bhi to phatt jata hai
Qabr ki god mein bachcha mera tanha hoga
Bano kehti thi ke Asghar mera pyasa hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
11
Kabhi soghra to Sakina ise behlati thi
Neend aaghosh mein behno ke ise aati thi
Aye shamim ab bhi wo tanhai mein rota hoga
Bano kehti thi ke Asghar mera pyasa hoga
author: Shamim Allahabadi
